name: Plnty
original_description: Make and change pictures and video with Plnty's creative tools, from the conversation. Attach a photo or pick one from your Plnty library, then ask for an edit, a set of variations, a cut-out, an upscale or a clip: the result lands in your library and shows right here. Before a creative run starts, Rothko, the assistant inside Plnty's canvas, picks the tool and writes the prompt. A clip can start from one still or bring up to nine pictures into one story. Bring in a picture from a link, find something you made before, or get a download link for your editing app. You can create a Plnty account when you connect, and work in your own workspace or a team's.
app_description: Make and change pictures and video with Plnty's creative tools, from the conversation. Ask for an edit, a set of variations, a cut-out, an upscale or a short clip from a still: the result lands in your Plnty library and shows right here. Bring in a picture from a link, find something you made before, or get a download link for your editing app. Connect your Plnty account; runs use its credits.
